aktion-state.comment: Reactive state references like $count, $user — the `$` sigil is what makes a binding reactive.

aktion-component-call.comment: PascalCase component invocations like Card( / Button( get a type-like color.

aktion-handle.comment: Reserved runtime handles surfaced as identifiers (route, aktion).
